title: finance-legal personal todo - march
content:
Quick scratchpad - finance/legal TODOs (personal)
Last updated: 2026-03-02
Owner: Maya Singh

Top priorities:
- [ ] Invoice cleanup: verify outstanding vendor invoices for Feb/Mar close (NetSuite INV-2026-0021, INV-2026-0023)
    - check PO numbers, match AP CSV exported 2026-03-01
    - confirm vendor tax IDs present (esp. CloudInfra LLC)
    - flag any >$10k items for manager approval (cc: Rita)
- [ ] Customer contract redlines: Acme Corp (renewal)
    - review redline v2 sent 2026-02-28 (see attached in thread)
    - my proposed positions: limit liability to standard clause, remove audit clause change, tighten data residency language to EU-only for this account
    - draft reply to account exec: include fallback options for on-prem deployment and KMS requirements
- [ ] Renewal reminders: schedule outreach for next 90/60/30 days
    - create calendar reminders for top 10 renewals this quarter
    - FIN-1234 covers renewals pipeline (see Jira)

Notes / loose thoughts:
- Quick check: did Legal already approve the new NDA template? I recall a comment from Samir but not final. Action: ping Samir in #legal (Slack) and attach link to Confluence page.
- For Acme redline: need input from Solutions Eng on latency guarantees if they request on-prem. Tag: @DevOps/SE for capacity estimate.
- Invoices: one vendor (DataViz Co) disputed rate on invoice INV-2026-0023; need backup of SOW (contract SOW-2019-07) and PO-6789. Check shared_drives/product/contract-archive for SOW scan.

Inbox / short actions (today):
- [ ] Attach INV-2026-0021 to NetSuite claim and tag Rita
- [ ] Reply to Acme exec w/ initial redline comments draft (by EOD)
- [ ] Create calendar reminders for renewals list (quick export from Salesforce)
- [ ] Confirm NDA template status with Samir

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who owns the Customer Tax ID validation step? (Ops currently?) Need clear owner to avoid hold-ups during month-end.
- Do we have an approved fallback CS template for on-prem compliance that Legal can sign off quickly?

Quick links & refs:
- Jira FIN board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-1234
- Invoice process doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/987654/invoice-process
- Contract archive (shared drive): shared_drives/legal/contract-archive
- Slack threads: #finance-invoices, #legal-contracts

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc low-friction: one-line reminders, then copy final items to official Confluence page when done.
- If Acme pushes on audit clause, propose quarterly scoped audit with notice and auditor list rather than open-ended.

Recent changes log (quick):
- 2026-02-20: created initial list after Feb close
- 2026-02-28: added Acme redline items after exec email
- 2026-03-02: updated invoice checks and added NetSuite IDs

-- Maya
